performance.cable-capacity-basis: Cat 6 24 AWG, 0.235 in (5.97 mm), at the 30% recommended fill of the front channel's 17.3 sq in usable area; 199 at the 50% maximum fill - Panduit Space-Saving Cable Management Rack Systems bulletin RKCB46, Cable Capacity Charts

physical.mounting-hardware: #12-24 mounting screws, as shipped with the cover

configs.description: The manager as Panduit ships NMF3, cover fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same manager with its cover opened, the finger walls and the channel open to lay a cable in. The cover comes with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: cover-off

gaps.note: the specification sheet says the dual hinged cover opens 110 degrees to the top or bottom without being removed; no view draws a hinge, and the cover is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of the cover's hinge

gaps.note: the NM3B front-to-rear pass-through blanking panel is a separate accessory (V10404BU-DC) that closes the two windows; it is not drawn and the windows are open.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the blanking panel fitted

gaps.note: no view sections the cover or the fingers: their thickness is estimated and the elevations draw the body without the cover's edge.
gaps.wanted: a section through a cover and a finger tip
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the NMF3 product page and the specification sheet (RKSP237); the temperatures are the customer drawing's.

bottom.note: drawing - the front view draws the same finger tips along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: datasheet - the Cable Capacity Charts of the Space-Saving bulletin (RKCB46) give the NMF3 per cable at 30 per cent recommended fill and 50 per cent maximum; the figure stated is the Cat 6 24 AWG 0.235 in (5.97 mm) column at 30 per cent, 119 (199 at 50 per cent). The Cable Capacity Calculator gives the usable area, 17.3 sq in.

chassis.note: estimated - 444.83 x 133 x 157. The drawing dimensions 482 [19.0 in] over the ears, 465 [18.3 in] between the fixing holes, 133 [5.2 in] high and 157 [6.2 in] deep; the body between the ears is the NCMH2 drawing's 444.83 [17.51 in] for the same moulding, which this drawing does not give. The ears are not drawn.

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the cover is drawn a shade lighter than the moulding.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The NMF3 customer drawing (Panduit V10404AI-DC) dimensions the channel "5.5 REF [140]" from the front of the cover to the end of the finger zone and the whole manager "6.2 REF [157]"; the mounting plate and its flange are the 17.3 behind. `at` is 139.7, so the ears bolt to the front face of the plate. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front with the cover fitted: the cover, and under it the two rows of T fingers end-on, the channel between them (113 high on the 133, estimated) and the two windows in the plate at the back of it, 85 high.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the part is 157 deep and 139.7 of it stands in front of the rails, so the rear face of its rack units stays free for another part.

guides.note: estimated - the duct is the channel between the two finger rows, run across the rack; pitch 34.925 and gap 5.4 as on the NMF2.

left.note: estimated - no side view is drawn; built from the plan view and the front view.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as the NMF2's are (see nmf2): the customer drawing (PDF V10404AI-DC, with a DXF and a DWG that hold only a trimetric projection, so no measurement), the NetManager High Capacity specification sheet RKSP237, the product page, the Space-Saving bulletin RKCB46 and the Cable Capacity Calculator. THE FIGURES THE DRAWING DIMENSIONS ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURE (the finger count and pitch, the crossbar, the windows) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

rear.note: drawing - the back of the plate with its two windows; five plates round them, sunk 0.05 inside the rear face. The windows are open; the blanking panel NM3B is a separate accessory.

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW CHANNEL, NOT A BOX (see nmf2): the plate on the front view as a well 139.7 deep with two open windows, the two walls of fingers standing in it, the cover across their tips and the back of the plate standing 17.3 proud of the rear face.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states a wall gauge for the ABS moulding. 2.5 is a moulded wall of this size; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: drawing - the plan view, rear at y=0: the plate and flange 17.3 deep, twelve stems 100 mm long with a crossbar on each tip, and the cover over the front 12.6 mm.

weight.note: drawing - 998 g [2.2 lb], the weight table of the NMF3 customer drawing (V10404AI-DC).
